model: All entries refer to the SAME joint population of three real standardized variables. Reported correlations are stipulated exact population values. The missing entry is unknown,not zero. Allow every positive-SEMIDEFINITE correlation completion,including singular boundaries. No Gaussian conditional-independence or latent-factor restriction is supplied.
target: Find the sharp admissible interval of r13,and the sharp interval of the coefficient of X1in the population least-squares projection of X3on[X1,X2]. The predictor2x2covariance is nonsingular even when the full completion is singular. Assess whether that coefficient sign is identified. Evaluate the zero-filled completion for strict positive definiteness and determine whether zero filling would make the residuals of X1and X3after linear adjustment for X2uncorrelated.
scope: A covariance-consistency and linear-projection problem;no causal effect or conditional independence of arbitrary non-Gaussian variables is inferred.
